decisions.reason: The location-based margin analysis kept its own dedicated page in both years, which signals it is a core, actively marketed offering for energy suppliers.

It slipped from a dedicated page to a mere mention, and similar tariff tools have already been dropped, but a regional electricity tariff calculator likely still serves as a supporting module for the firm's energy-market software.

Its visibility dropped to a mention, yet a regional area definition tool is probably a foundational component underlying the location-based analyses, so removing it is less likely than for standalone comparison tools.
